findings.label: 30K shared prefix is short of 4 x 55K
findings.detail: Option A (user-approved): 55K = 35 blocks/seq; with S shared full attention blocks 4 x 55K needs 140 - 3S vs 104 usable. A ~30K prefix gives S = 10 -> 110 blocks, so one request still waits; all four run only with >= ~34.2K shared (S >= 12).
findings.action: In live-verify case (2), expect Running=3/Waiting=1 at ~30K sharing and report the actual Zoo prefix length with the result; that data feeds the Option B decision.
